name: How long does a bathroom marble installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom marble installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical bathroom marble installation takes about one to three weeks, depending on project scale. Minor floor tiling may take three to four days, including surface preparation and grouting. A complete bathroom remodel featuring marble shower walls, floors, and custom vanities takes longer. Demolition, structural leveling, and continuous waterproofing take several days before setting stone. After setting marble with stone-safe mortar, installers must allow proper cure time before grouting, followed by clean drying before applying penetrating sealer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation generally takes 3 to 14 days. Timeline depends on demolition, surface leveling, waterproofing, tile or slab setting, proper cure times, and final stone sealing.
